imagegenProvenance.prompt: Precise single-region correction to this existing garment UV base-color atlas. Keep EVERYTHING identical except the one upright cloth UV island on the far right in the UPPER HALF (approximately x=79%-98%, y=20%-55%). That island is part of the SHIRT, and was mistakenly left charcoal. Recolor only that one island to the same muted olive-green cotton as the other shirt islands below it, preserving its fine woven texture, stitching, exact shape, exact placement, black boundaries and tonal detail. Keep both large trouser islands across the top charcoal unchanged. Keep all existing olive lower shirt islands unchanged. Keep black background, all other pixels, framing, source credit, stitching and button locations unchanged. Technical flat diffuse atlas; no new lighting, no new shapes, no text additions. Same exact image dimensions and UV layout.

capImagegenProvenance.prompt: Edit this licensed CC0 game hair diffuse UV texture into an original premium contemporary civilian's deep neutral brown, short naturally swept hair texture. This is a technical flat BASE COLOR + ALPHA texture atlas, not a portrait. Preserve the exact square composition, positions, relative sizes, boundaries, orientations and internal flow directions of EVERY existing UV island. The two large irregular scalp islands on the left must remain where they are, including their cutouts; preserve the two sideburn islands and the many small strip islands along the top and right. Replace coarse gray smears and flat reflective gray bands with finely resolved, irregular, naturally overlapping individual brown hair strands. Keep the roots dark and the fine strand variation subtle but visible. Diffuse color only: remove baked specular reflections, studio highlights and lighting gradients; no painted gray/white shine, metallic areas, broad ribbon bands, new shadows or depth effects. Maintain transparent empty space and fine wispy alpha edges in the same UV layout; no new islands or changed geometry. Preserve texture detail across both large islands at close viewing scale. No face, skin, scalp photograph, head, person, text, logo, watermark, labels, grid or border. High resolution, square 2048 by 2048 technical game texture. Native transparent background.

browImagegenProvenance.prompt: Edit this licensed CC0 eyebrow diffuse UV texture into a realistic fine-hair BASE COLOR plus ALPHA game texture for an original contemporary adult civilian. Preserve exactly the two existing eyebrow islands: same positions, dimensions, curvature, taper, orientation, hair-flow direction, and transparent gap between them. Do not move, rotate, mirror, enlarge, or add islands. Replace the coarse solid painted strokes with individual fine deep-neutral-brown eyebrow hairs, natural subtle warm variation, many tapered strands, soft sparse outer edges and denser but still strand-resolved interiors. Keep the brows groomed and natural, not heavy cosmetic makeup, not solid charcoal bars. Fine strand separation should remain visible at medium texture size. Flat unlit diffuse color only: no highlights, drop shadow, ambient shading or skin underlay. Native transparent background with smooth hair alpha edges, no face, eyes, person, labels, text, border or watermark. Square texture atlas. Preserve original layout precisely.
